# Fit Bounds

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

The camera that fits rows into the render surface: wire its view state into the deck, or its longitude, latitude and zoom into a View State. The bounds are computed in DuckDB.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "fit-bounds", "name": "fit-bounds", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

One out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "viewState"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:padding`, or read elsewhere as `ch('fit-bounds/padding')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
This operator has no input ports.
<!-- gen:end inputs -->
